--- 
title: "Development Indicators by Continent"
author: "Gapminder Analytics Group"
format: dashboard
--- 

```{r}
# Global setup
library(tidyverse)
library(gapminder)
library(scales)

df <- gapminder
latest_year <- max(df$year)
```

## Row {height=60%}

```{r}
#| title: GDP and Life Expectancy 
df |>
filter(year == latest_year) |>
ggplot(aes(x = gdpPercap, y = lifeExp,
size = pop, color = continent)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
facet_wrap(~ continent) +
scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma(),
limits = c(100, 100000)) +
scale_y_continuous(limits = c(25, 90)) +
scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 15), guide = "none") +
labs(x = "GDP per capita (log scale)",
y = "Life expectancy (years)",
color = "Continent",
title = paste("GDP vs Life Expectancy —", latest_year)) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
theme(legend.position = "bottom",
plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

## Row {height=40%}

```{r}
#| title: Population
pop_by_cont <- df |>
group_by(year, continent) |>
summarise(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(pop_by_cont, aes(x = year, y = pop, fill = continent)) +
geom_area() +
scale_y_continuous(
labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale())
) +
labs(x = NULL, y = "Population",
fill = "Continent",
title = "Population by Continent Over Time") +
theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
theme(legend.position = "bottom",
plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
#| title: Life Expectancy
ggplot(df, aes(x = year, y = lifeExp,
group = country, color = continent)) +
geom_line(alpha = 0.35) +
labs(x = NULL, y = "Life expectancy (years)",
color = "Continent",
title = "Life Expectancy Trends by Country") +
theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
theme(legend.position = "bottom",
plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
